text_simplified: The text calls parents to make the home a small kingdom where children recite the Qur'an and learn the Seerah of the Prophet ﷺ. It mentions that the true orphan is the one deprived of affection and care, not just the one who has lost their parents. It emphasizes the importance of a father embracing his daughter, kissing her, and seating her beside him, just as the Prophet ﷺ did with his daughter Fatimah. It warns parents against neglecting their children after their marriage or becoming too preoccupied with other matters.

review_defects.english: becoming too preoccupied with other matters
review_defects.why: The English adds 'other matters' and 'too', which are not present in the Arabic. The Arabic only says 'their being busy/occupied away from them' without specifying the cause or intensity.
